title: The end of another era
summary: After more than 20 years at Castleshaw, Eileen, our long-serving warden, has moved on to new challenges.
body: After more than 20 years at Castleshaw, Eileen, our long-serving warden, has moved on to new challenges. She may not miss cleaning up after classes of muddy children, but we’re sure she’ll miss feeding the goats. We’ll certainly miss her. All the best, Eileen!

title: Raising the roof
alt: Council officers and staff outside the centre
summary: Castleshaw is one of 140 youth projects in England to receive a Youth Investment Fund grant, for improvements to the roof.
body: Castleshaw is one of 140 youth projects in England to receive a Youth Investment Fund grant, for improvements to the roof. Councillor Shaid Mushtaq, Cabinet Member for Children and Young People, said the centre “provides opportunities for people to enjoy activities they may otherwise have never had the chance to experience”.

title: Bushcraft sessions
alt: Bushcraft tools and kindling on a stump
summary: Congratulations to Matt, who has completed his NCFE Level 2 Bushcraft Instructor Award.
body: Congratulations to Matt, who has completed his NCFE Level 2 Bushcraft Instructor Award. He and Chiron are looking forward to sharing these skills with more groups.

title: Our new centre manager
summary: Joseph Myhill joins as centre manager, looking forward to meeting the many groups who use the centre and making plans with those who would like to.
body: Joseph Myhill joins as centre manager, looking forward to meeting the many groups who use the centre and making plans with those who would like to.

title: SUP-er!
alt: Two people on stand up paddleboards on the reservoir
summary: Young people in Oldham’s Youth Service asked if they could try paddleboarding.
body: Young people in Oldham’s Youth Service asked if they could try paddleboarding. We listened: we now have our own small fleet of boards, the activity is on our licence, and we have more wetsuits too.

title: A Peak District Ambassador Centre
alt: A reservoir in a green valley
summary: We are now an Ambassador Centre for the Peak District National Park.
body: We are now an Ambassador Centre for the Peak District National Park.
